title: OpenDesign
author: Lumzel
description: Local-first AI design studio inspired by OpenDesign (nexu-io/open-design): DESIGN.md brand contracts, structured discovery-to-build workflows, live interactive canvas with element inspection, token tweaks, pinned comment revisions, and anti-slop quality gates.
